parameters.item/alex_resultdescription: PayPlus payment approved by Workbench processing flow.

parameters.$filter: alex_documenttypecode eq 'inv_tax' and alex_payplusdocumentuuid ne null and _alex_billingcaseid_value eq @{body('Get_billing_case')?['alex_payplusbillingcaseid']}
alex_documenttypecode eq 'inv_proforma' and alex_payplusdocumentuuid ne null and _alex_billingcaseid_value eq @{body('Get_billing_case')?['alex_payplusbillingcaseid']}

select.name: @coalesce(item()?['name'], item()?['alex_sourceitemname'], item()?['alex_name'], 'Payment item')
select.price: @coalesce(if(greater(float(coalesce(item()?['amount_pay'], 0)), 0), item()?['amount_pay'], null), if(greater(float(coalesce(item()?['alex_actualallocatedamount'], 0)), 0), item()?['alex_actualallocatedamount'], null), if(greater(float(coalesce(item()?['alex_allocatedamount'], 0)), 0), item()?['alex_allocatedamount'], null), if(greater(float(coalesce(item()?['alex_proposedamount'], 0)), 0), item()?['alex_proposedamount'], null), item()?['price'], item()?['quantity_price'], 0)

parameters.item/alex_resultdescription: @concat('Payment approved and PayPlus receipt issued', if(empty(coalesce(outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['number'], outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['document_number'], '')), '.', concat(': ', coalesce(outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['number'], outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['document_number']))))

parameters.item/alex_documentstatussummary: @concat('Payment approved and PayPlus receipt issued', if(empty(coalesce(outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['number'], outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['document_number'], '')), '.', concat(': ', coalesce(outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['number'], outputs('Compose_receipt_data_check')?['document_number']))))

parameters.item/alex_resultdescription: @concat('Checks recorded but PayPlus receipt creation failed: ', coalesce(outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['results']?['description'], outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['description'], outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['error'], outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['message'], 'unknown error'))

parameters.item/alex_documentstatussummary: @concat('Checks receipt failed and was rolled back: ', coalesce(outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['results']?['description'], outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['description'], outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['error'], outputs('Compose_receipt_result_check')?['message'], 'unknown error'))
